purpose: Give new bounded work-transfer packets a strict egress law while retaining the broad legacy adapter for recovered historical packet shapes.

canonical_fields.OBJECT: Required. Exact addressed thing carried by the packet.
canonical_fields.AUTHORITY: Required. Source/owner/current marker; a packet egress label alone never creates GATE or NOW.
canonical_fields.DELTA: Optional material change. Canonical DELTA requires EVIDENCE or the packet reduces to RESIDUE.
canonical_fields.EVIDENCE: Proof/source references supporting a claimed material DELTA.
canonical_fields.RESIDUE: Unresolved returned work, contradiction, defect, or uncertainty.
canonical_fields.WAITING: External human/device/world/private prerequisite; maps to GATE.
canonical_fields.NEXT: Fresh candidate continuation; 0..3 only. More than 3 maps to RESIDUE.
canonical_fields.STOP: Disposition marker. Conditional STOP maps to GATE; terminal STOP with unresolved material maps to RESIDUE; completed terminal STOP maps to ARCHIVE.

return_dispositions.TRIGGER: NEXT only when a bounded NEXT exists and execution is explicitly authorized; otherwise GATE

canonical_rules: Missing OBJECT/AUTHORITY or unknown RETURN disposition -> ARCHIVE quarantine.
Conditional STOP / WAITING / blocked TRIGGER -> GATE.
Terminal STOP + unresolved material -> RESIDUE; terminal STOP + no residue -> ARCHIVE.
Unresolved fact / CONTRADICTION / RETURN RESIDUE -> RESIDUE.
Canonical DELTA with EVIDENCE and no higher egress -> DELTA.

legacy_compatibility.law: Packets that do not declare field-work-packet/v0.1 and do not carry both object+authority retain broad legacy field recognition under the recovered GATE -> NOW -> RESIDUE -> NEXT -> DELTA -> ARCHIVE precedence.
legacy_compatibility.non_promotion: Historical/superseded legacy packets remain ARCHIVE unless explicitly reactivated; packet labels cannot manufacture GATE/NOW.

invariants: RETURN closes the previous move; NEXT is a fresh offer.
SUCCESSFUL CLOSE disappears from ordinary attention.
INVALID canonical packets quarantine to ARCHIVE and cannot alter CONTROL.
No packet reducer creates a queue, planner, route, store, priority, or effect authority.
